llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization (domestic for-profit entity initial registration)
llc.formation_notes: Filed through DLCP CorpOnline. A DC Basic Business License is also generally required ($99 for a 2-year general business license; $49 for 6 months, $198 for 4 years).

annual_report.name: Biennial Report
annual_report.due: April 1 of the year due (every two years)
annual_report.late_penalty: $100 late fee for for-profit entities filed after April 1

state_tax_on_llc.name: Unincorporated Business Franchise Tax (UBT, Form D-30)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: Unincorporated businesses, including LLCs and sole proprietorships, with DC gross receipts over $12,000
state_tax_on_llc.notes: 8.25% of net income after a 30% salary allowance for owners and a $5,000 exemption. Minimum tax $250 if DC gross receipts are $1M or less, $1,000 if more. Exempt if more than 80% of gross income comes from owners' personal services and capital is not a material income-producing factor, or if the profession cannot by law be incorporated.

sources.title: DLCP License & Corporate Filing Fees

sources.title: DC Business Franchise Tax Rates - OTR
sources.quote: A 30% salary allowance for owners and a $5,000 exemption are deductible from net income to arrive at taxable income.

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporation franchise tax (Form D-20)
entity_level_taxes.notes: S corporations must file the D-20 and pay the 8.25% corporate franchise tax like C corporations (DC does not follow the federal S election). Minimum $250 if DC gross receipts are $1M or less, $1,000 if more.

sources.title: Franchise Tax FAQs - DC OTR
sources.quote: including small businesses, professional corporations, and S corporations, if they carry on or engage in any trade, business, or commercial activity in the District

personal_exemption.notes: No personal exemption. Same brackets for all filing statuses. 2026 standard deduction from the 2026 D-40ES worksheet ($24,150 head of household); additional amount for aged/blind $1,650 ($2,050 unmarried).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None beyond the 10.75% top bracket over $1,000,000

sources.title: 2026 D-40ES Estimated Payment for Individual Income Tax
sources.quote: enter $16,100 if single ... Enter $32,200 if married/registered domestic partner filing jointly

sources.title: DC Individual and Fiduciary Income Tax Rates
sources.quote: Over $1,000,000 $91,525, plus 10.75% of the excess above $1,000,000.

estimated_tax.required_if: You expect your DC tax liability to be greater than $100
estimated_tax.notes: Businesses filing D-20/D-30 must pay estimated franchise tax if liability is more than $1,000.

unemployment_2026.notes: New employers pay the higher of 2.7% or the average contribution rate of all employers in the preceding year (2026 average not published on the page read). Wage base $9,000 per the DOES rate FAQ example (undated). DC Paid Family Leave employer tax is separate and was not verified.

local_taxes.name: Unincorporated Business Franchise Tax
local_taxes.applies: Sole proprietorships, partnerships and LLCs carrying on business in DC with gross receipts over $12,000 (on top of DC individual income tax)
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Gross receipts $12,000 or less: not taxable. 30% owner salary allowance and $5,000 exemption. Exempt if >80% of gross income is from owners' personal services and capital is not material. Minimum $250 / $1,000.
local_taxes.quote: Net income of unincorporated businesses on a combined reporting basis with gross receipts more than $12,000.

notable: DC does not recognize S corporations: they pay the 8.25% franchise tax, so an S election brings no DC benefit (https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/franchise-tax-faqs)

Sole proprietors and LLCs owe the 8.25% unincorporated business tax above $12,000 of gross receipts unless they qualify for the personal-services exemption (https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/dc-business-franchise-tax-rates)
Estimated tax is required once you owe more than $100 (https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/underpayment-estimated-tax-interest)
Biennial report costs $300 for an LLC (https://dlcp.dc.gov/page/dlcp-license-corporate-filing-fees)
uncertain: UBT/franchise tax rate table on the OTR page lists years through 2025 (8.25%); 2026 rate assumed unchanged at 8.25% (no change found, but not shown for 2026).
UBT credit against individual income tax: DC allows no credit; owners pay both (not re-verified today).
SUTA wage base $9,000 from an undated DOES FAQ example; 2026 new-employer average rate not found.
DC Paid Family Leave employer contribution rate for 2026 not verified (web search budget exhausted).
